messages:
sylvie: Working on PR #5621 — need a tiny, customer-facing section for 'Rate limits & Quotas' that shows: 1) a single-line formula for allowance, 2) a micro SDK example, 3) one migration note for legacy meter headers. Keep it compact. cc @ashok @nora
ashok: I can do the micro SDK snippet. Preference: show minutes->allowance formula and a worked 10-minute example. JS is preferred.
sylvie: Yes — formula should be: allowance = per_min * minutes. Add a short sentence about enforcement rounding (floor to whole tokens) and that cost estimates show two decimals.
nora: I'll add the migration one-liner: "Legacy meter headers should be mapped to X-Redwood-Usage-Tier; recompute allowances from per_min/per_day fields." Also add a note that percent-based alerts use percent_of_daily and round to whole percents.
ashok: Draft JS snippet (very compact):```js
// minutes -> allowance (floored)
function allowance(per_min, minutes){
  return Math.floor(per_min * minutes);
}
// example: pro (per_min=300) for 10 minutes =>
console.log(allowance(300, 10)) // 3000
```
sylvie: Great. Add a tiny Ruby curl example as an alternative for quick ops copy-paste:```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?range=today" | jq '.tokens'
```
ashok: Also include this one-line UX callout: "Burst credits are excluded from percent_of_daily until consumed; alerts and UI reflect consumed amounts."
ops-bot: Reminder: Do not include internal console URLs in public docs; link to /docs/usage-dashboard for panel screenshots.
docs-bot: l10n-check queued for PR #5621. Please mark code snippets runnable where possible.
sylvie: Action list: ashok - push JS snippet + Ruby curl; nora - add migration line + alert rounding sentence + link to /docs/usage-dashboard; i'll merge once docs-bot passes and a screenshot is attached. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
